what: Hook auto-update implemented (not deferred): On MCP server start, autoUpdateIfNeeded() checks _aideMemoryVersion in .claude/settings.json. If missing or older than current package version, auto-merges hooks, MCP config, and rules files — preserving user's other settings. No manual init --force needed for upgrades. --force also now merges instead of overwriting. Version stamp written to settings.json after update.
why: User wanted auto-update now, not Phase 2. Implemented in server.ts startServer() calling init.ts autoUpdateIfNeeded().
